extracted.intended_audience: current NIGMS grantees, applicants, and others in the scientific community seeking information on funding opportunities, meetings, resources, and related guidance
extracted.subtask_description: A landing-page/blog that posts NIGMS announcements (funding opportunities, webinars, program goals, and administrative guidance) aimed at prospective and current grant applicants and grantees. The page summarizes deadlines, program scope, eligibility notes, and links to program-specific notices (PARs/NOTs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative supplement eligibility (PA-20-272)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requests must be within the scope of the approved grant award and must be in response to something that was unanticipated when the competing application was submitted. In addition, the award to be supplemented must be active and cannot be in a no-cost extension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PA-20-272, Administrative Supplements to Existing NIH Grants and Cooperative Agreements (Parent Admin Supp Clinical Trial Optional), and any subsequent reissuances. For consideration in FY25, applicants are strongly encouraged to submit supplement requests by April 18, 2025.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instrumentation Grant Program for Resource-Limited Institutions (RLI-S10, PAR-23-138) — deadline and target
rubrics_metrics.description: Webinar for Instrumentation Grant Program for Resource-Limited Institutions (RLI-S10) (PAR-23-138). The next application deadline is July 3, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program targets resource-limited institutions; attend the informational webinar to learn program specifics and application expectations. (The page states 'The RLI-S10 program goals include:' but the detailed list is provided on the program page/PAR.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Trans-Departmental Basic Biomedical Sciences (TBB) program goals (PAR-23-228)
rubrics_metrics.description: The goals are to broaden the scope and the institutional and geographic distribution of NIGMS basic biomedical research training programs, as well as to enhance research training capacity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unlike programs focused on specific scientific areas, the TBB program provides students with research training opportunities from the breadth of biomedical disciplines at participating organizations. TBB is one of 12 basic biomedical sciences areas NIGMS supports; see PAR-23-228 for full solicitation details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biomedical Technology Optimization and Dissemination (BTOD) center structure
rubrics_metrics.description: BTOD centers are built around three tightly integrated components: Technology optimization projects; Driving biomedical projects; Community engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: BTOD supports creation of centers dedicated to optimizing and broadly disseminating state-of-the-art, mission-relevant, late-stage technologies to both experts and nonexperts in biomedical research (refer to diagram on the BTOD page for integration and operational details). See PAR-23-110 for the full funding opportunity.

rubrics_metrics.name: PREP (Postbaccalaureate Research Education Program) applicant guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: PREP’s goal is to develop a well-trained pool of postbaccalaureates who will transition into and complete rigorous biomedical, research-focused doctoral degree programs (such as Ph.D. or M.D./Ph.D.) in biomedical fields relevant to the NIGMS mission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Potential applicants are encouraged to join virtual office hours for an overview of the PREP funding opportunity and to ask programmatic, budget, and scientific review questions. Interested parties are strongly encouraged to review the 2022 PREP prospective applicant webinar, companion slide deck (PDF), and NOT-GM-24-010 for recent budget guidance before attending.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advancing Research Careers (ARC) program components and routing (PAR-25-084, PAR-23-221)
rubrics_metrics.description: ARC has two components: an individual predoctoral-to-postdoctoral career transition award (F99/K00; PAR-25-084) and an institutional research education cooperative agreement (UE5; PAR-23-221).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ARC is part of NIH efforts to promote broad participation within the biomedical research workforce. Potential applicants should attend the informational webinar to learn which component applies to them and to get details on application components and requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH Research Enhancement Awards (R15) webinar guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: If you or other principal investigators at your institution are preparing a grant application for the NIH Research Enhancement Awards (R15) program, join the webinar to learn about the various NIH R15 programs, the one NIGMS participates in, and application components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The webinar provides an opportunity to ask questions about program scope and application components; registration details and Zoom links are posted on the announcement.
